_readme: Data file for tier-router.js's keyword heuristic. Edit freely to tune routing - no code changes needed. Each guideGroups entry matches via 'keywords' (plain substring OR, case-insensitive) or 'regex' (JS RegExp source, tested with the 'i' flag); 'guides' is the exact text printed when it matches. Order of guideGroups is the print order. This file travels with tier-router.js on install/update since it lives in the same skill folder.
